title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer (Fastly, Cloudflare/Akamai)
description:
**About the role:**
 The Gartner SRE team's mission is to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and high\-performing digital platforms that power Gartner's business and elevate customer experiences through a culture of reliability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to serve as senior technical leader responsible for advancing the reliability, resilience, performance, automation, and governance of Gartner's digital platforms. With a focus on global CDN and edge delivery capabilities, you will shape platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and drive cross\-functional initiatives that improve operational maturity, accelerate delivery, and ensure exceptional customer experiences.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Deliver world\-class availability, stability, and performance for our digital products, ensuring a consistent and positive user experience for customers.
* Establish multi\-CDN architecture patterns, traffic\-steering strategies, failover mechanisms, and operational standards to achieve five\-nines (99\.999%) availability targets.
* Lead CDN incident response, disaster recovery exercises, capacity planning, and performance optimization initiatives to ensure uninterrupted customer experiences during internet\-scale events.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, and Application Development teams to implement and optimize edge security capabilities including DDoS protection, WAF policies, bot management, and edge compute services.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to manage CDN configurations, governance policies, observability, WAF rules, and deployment processes.
* Design, build, and maintain global traffic management policies, including DNS routing, certificate management, and load balancing, to meet disaster recovery (DR) and high\-availability (HA) requirements.
* Design and implement edge\-computing solutions using Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge, or equivalent technologies to address key application use cases.
* Define and monitor CDN\-specific SLOs, SLIs, and KPIs including cache hit ratio, origin offload, latency, availability, and traffic distribution across providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve the performance, scalability, and stability of applications across the full technology stack.
* Participate in operational support and on\-call rotations to provide timely incident response for supported systems and applications.
* Lead production incident resolution efforts, triage application and system issues, identify root causes, and implement remediation measures to restore services quickly.
* Develop alerting strategies, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to communicate operational and business critical metrics.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational work (i.e., “toil”) using pipelines, new software, or any other appropriate mechanisms.
* Drive system design consulting, platform management, capacity planning, and launch reviews.
* Partner with application teams to design and implement chaos engineering practices that improve resilience and fault tolerance.
* Establish strong relationships with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to define and manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage, collaborate and share lessons learned regarding CDN architecture and deployments with all stakeholders, including developers, other SREs, operations teams, and project management teams.
* Improve customer experience and increase product value by enhancing the reliability, availability, and performance of client\-facing applications and service
* Internal relationships are critical to establish with application development teams and technology teams such as database, cloud/infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.


**What you will need:**
**Must Have**
* Expert knowledge of one or two enterprise CDN platforms, including Fastly, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Akamai, or equivalent technologies, with hands\-on experience designing, operating, and optimizing multi\-CDN environments.
* Experience implementing multi\-CDN routing and failover solutions using DNS, GSLB, traffic management platforms, or real\-user\-performance (RUM) driven traffic steering.
* Experience in managing large\-scale CDN platforms using Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, or provider specific automation frameworks such as Fastly VCL, Cloudflare APIs or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline governance, code promotions, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code best practices to enable consistent, automated deployments across environments.
* Expertise in CDN observability, performance analytics, log analysis, and troubleshooting user experience issues across global regions and internet service providers.
* Strong understanding of edge security services including WAF, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, rate limiting, and zero\-trust access controls.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with strong verbal and written communication capabilities.


**Good To have:**
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities and technologies, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Experience in collaborating with Development, Cloud and Architecture teams or other relevant teams to conduct RCA, drive mission critical initiatives
* Experience building Cloudflare Workers and snippets, AWS Lambda@Edge functions, Fastly VCL, and Fastly Compute solutions.
* Experience with client\-side technologies such as NodeJS, JavaScript, React JQuery and utilizing CDN features to improve UI performance
* Hands\-on experience creating ACM certificates in Fastly, Cloudflare, or AWS.
* Exposure with monitoring tools like Splunk, Grafana and APM tools such as Dynatrace, or equivalent
* Proficient in Operating Systems (UNIX/Linux) \& networking concepts.
* Exposure to Performance \& chaos Engineering concepts


**Who you are :**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 8\+ years of information technology experience with 6\+ years working on DevOps/SRE team or similar with focus on CDN.
* Knowledge of Agile approaches to software development and ability to put key Agile principles into practice to deliver solutions incrementally.
* Excellent analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with strong ability to influence both IT and business partners.
* Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, team leadership, and fostering a positive team culture.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.

We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. **What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

 The ideal candidate is hands\-on, comfortable owning infrastructure end\-to\-end, and passionate about automation and operational excellence. You should have strong experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and Linux\-based systems, along with a strong troubleshooting mindset.

* Design, implement, and maintain reliable and secure infrastructure for development, testing, and production environments.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, enabling faster, safer, and more consistent software delivery.
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on Azure and exposure to other major cloud platforms.
* Design and manage scalable infrastructure across autoscaling compute, networking, and security controls.
* Build, deploy, and maintain containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Work closely with developers to establish self\-service tools and automation that improve engineering productivity.
* Advance our infrastructure and application security posture across hardening, access control, and DevOps security practices.
* Own and scale our monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident\-response practice to improve system reliability and observability.
* Maintain and improve production environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive continued platform modernization and help evolve engineering processes toward modern DevOps practices.
* Own backup and disaster recovery — including regular restore testing — alongside system administration and operational resilience.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, networking, and production issues and participate in incident resolution.
* Continuously review existing infrastructure and processes against industry best practices and recommend improvements.
* Work closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to improve deployment quality, reliability, and delivery velocity.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and support critical production systems when required.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3–4 years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related role.
* Strong practical experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Good understanding of Docker and Kubernetes and experience running production workloads in containerized environments.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automating software delivery workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform/OpenTofu or similar Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Good understanding of networking, security, system hardening, and production infrastructure.
* Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Familiarity with databases, caching, messaging, and supporting infrastructure components is an advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and other engineering teams.
* Good understanding of DevOps principles, automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production (AKS or equivalent).
* Experience operating production datastores, caching layers, message queues, and log/search platforms.
* Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and integrating security into CI/CD workflows.
* Experience migrating applications to modern cloud\-native environments.



  





**Why Join Voxy?** 



* Work on infrastructure supporting a modern, cloud\-based product and engineering environment.
* Take ownership of meaningful initiatives across DevOps, cloud infrastructure, automation, security, and reliability.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams and influence how applications are built, deployed, and operated.
* Work with modern cloud\-native technologies including Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, and observability platforms.
* Help shape engineering practices around automation, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Join a team where engineers are encouraged to solve problems, take ownership, and continuously improve the platform.
* Opportunity to make a direct impact on the scalability, reliability, and developer experience of Voxy’s technology ecosystem.
